sections.title: Right now
lines: Wave 1 (lowest rung only), fight about Sat 9:55pm CT. Sold 160, 4,415 resting. Worst line -$111 (target -$150). Bot is slow (checks every 1m, set for 45s).

sections.title: Lagging sides
lines: Lagging (150+ behind the leader): Buckley by KO/TKO, Malott by Decision, Malott by KO/TKO, Malott by Submission.
Buckley by KO/TKO: 130 behind. Steps to 30c if the crowd trades lower.
Malott by Decision: 130 behind. Steps to 24c if the crowd trades lower.
A price step needs 20 min with no fill and the crowd paying less.

sections.title: Next wave of contracts
lines: Full ladder posts Sat 9:00am CT: 3,000 more contracts across 5 buckets.
A bucket gets a new batch when its resting drops under 25% of its allotment.
Gate closed: batches wait for the worst line to reach -$100 (now -$111).

sections.title: Tightening
lines: Backstop off. It trips if a bucket's line falls under -$500.
Paid balancing starts Sat 7:55pm CT: worst line to -$150, up to $100.
Even-up Sat 9:25pm CT; last-resort take Sat 9:50pm CT; handoff to the fight Sat 9:52pm CT.
The fight start is an estimate and can move.

sections.title: Will it adapt on its own?
lines: Mostly yes: the full ladder, extra batches, price steps and paid balancing run by rule. The start time can shift.
